_comment: Not on any runtime classpath (coreLibraryDesugaring in app/build.gradle.kts), so AboutLibraries cannot list it. Text: LICENSE of google/desugar_jdk_libs, unchanged since commit af7193bb1f81c050395c7273ee0354630a295d2f (2023-09-27), which the 2.1.4 POM names.
name: desugar_jdk_libs
description: Core library desugaring: OpenJDK library classes (java.time and others) that the build compiles into the APK's dex, unmodified, for flutter_local_notifications. Built by Google from the OpenJDK 11 sources in https://github.com/google/desugar_jdk_libs; Maven com.android.tools:desugar_jdk_libs:2.1.4.
